subject.title: [Feature]: Add Ralph Loop feature and add max iteration number into the agent configuration

question: Should OpenClaw accept the opt-in per-agent iteration-budget contract proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97485 as the core solution for this Ralph-loop default request, and with which names, precedence, budget unit, and exhaustion behavior?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but adding public config and agent-loop semantics is a product/runtime contract that automation should not finalize without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve or narrow the active PR
options.body: Settle the config names, default-off behavior, precedence, unsupported-harness behavior, and exhaustion result on the active PR, then merge or request a focused revision.

options.title: Design a different loop contract
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers design a separate Ralph-specific or broader agent-loop budget model before implementation.

options.title: Decline core loop budgets
options.body: Close this issue and related requests only if maintainers decide existing loop detection, model choice, and operator timeouts are the supported direction.

recommendation.title: Approve or narrow the active PR
recommendation.body: Settle the config names, default-off behavior, precedence, unsupported-harness behavior, and exhaustion result on the active PR, then merge or request a focused revision.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is assigned to the active implementation candidate and authored the latest budget-exhaustion follow-up commits.
